mechanism: Pantoprazole inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, potentially increasing modafinil plasma concentrations, while modafinil may induce CYP3A4, creating bidirectional metabolic interaction.
action: Monitor for increased modafinil effects (insomnia, anxiety, tachycardia); consider dose adjustment of modafinil if adverse effects emerge; separate administration timing may provide minimal benefit given hepatic metabolism interactions.
